instruments.name: Pulse Lead
instruments.description: A bright, narrow pulse with a quick attack and a touch of glide, the classic NES melody voice.

instruments.name: Glide Lead
instruments.description: A single-note filtered sawtooth that slides between notes, for expressive solos and bends.

instruments.name: Sub Bass
instruments.description: A deep sine with a gentle lowpass sweep, felt more than heard under the rest of the mix.

instruments.name: Warm Strings
instruments.description: A detuned sawtooth ensemble behind a slowly opening lowpass, like a string machine section.

instruments.name: Marimba
instruments.description: A short, woody FM mallet hit whose bright knock fades in a blink, for bouncy ostinatos.

instruments.name: Drawbar Organ
instruments.description: Sine and triangle stops an octave below, at, and above the note, held steady like a tonewheel organ.

instruments.name: Sisterly
instruments.description: Warm, motherly mid voice that sounds like it is about to give advice.

instruments.name: House Kit
instruments.description: A punchy 909-style dance machine: a short, thick kick and a deeper, longer one, a hard snare, a big clap, crisp hats that choke each other, toms, rim, crash, ride, and cowbell on the General MIDI drum notes.
